consumer: Character::craft's call to select_crafting_recipe (src/crafting_gui.cpp), which asks the player to browse/filter and interactively pick a recipe (and batch size) through the engine's own input loop, returning the chosen recipe or nullptr on cancel.
scope: the interactive recipe-selection input loop over the crafter's available recipes, answered through the real active input loop -- not a re-derivation from any item snapshot.
decisive_source: src/crafting_gui.cpp::select_crafting_recipe -- runs a full-screen interactive crafting menu answered through the engine's own input loop and returns the picked recipe (nullptr on cancel); the item-export writers (write_carried_items / write_entities) only SHOW item stacks and are not the load-bearing consumer.
divergence: Backend 're-derives' the craft by selecting the first matching recipe from a computed craftable list instead of driving select_crafting_recipe: where the player would have browsed, filtered, and cancelled (nullptr -> no craft), the shortcut still crafts; or where the player would pick the 3rd recipe, the shortcut crafts the 1st -- a wrong/silently-defaulted selection an interactive drive would expose.
